title: Make RFC11-4 satisfiable and the golden fixtures testable
description: Criteria 8 and 9 of the readiness report, both NOT MET, from review RD-5. (1) RFC11-4 requires the governing phase-rule clause of every selected contract; 6 of 353 clause rows carry that kind and RFC-0001..0005 have none, so a conformant selector fail-closes on all nine fixtures. Give those five a phase-rule clause, or narrow RFC11-4's universal. (2) State the depends_on termination rule in RFC11-4 — fixture 9's formulation is the only one written down and is ready to lift verbatim; the nine fixtures currently apply at least three different unstated ones. (3) Add governs/applies_to to governance_sources, or state that doctrine and craft selection is judgment and not claimed deterministic. (4) Split each fixture into a ## Task block (objective, warrant, risk class) with the trace and selection strictly below a line — RD-5 could not derive blind because each answer's reasoning sits above its question. (5) Extend CG-18 past the headline: ~70 of 88 fixture measurements are checked by nothing and at least five contradict their own headline. (6) Repair fixture 5's budget prose (it states a 22,260-token packet is inside the 15-20k target) and reconcile fixtures 1 and 8, which apply opposite readings of RFC11-4's phase-rule parenthetical to the same contract. (7) Re-scope fixture 2 or add a tenth: the adapter class is double-counted and Trajectory lifecycle is covered by a fixture omitting work identity, dispatch, materialization, accounting and release.
acceptance_criteria: A competent human given only each fixture's task block reproduces its selection; RFC11-4 is satisfiable over all eleven contracts; every fixture measurement is recomputed by a check; eight required classes covered by eight distinct fixtures with no double-count.

title: Split the RFC-0010 package, then repair the six blocking Mission-safety findings
description: Two independent reviews over sha256 7f823aa3 returned REVISE. RFC-0010 sits at 6749 of 7000 words with its amendment log and 21 violation cases already in Tier 2 — there is no room left to repair in, which is the structural signal that the package needs splitting first. Then B1 (bind reservation to enforced limits at the RFC5-21 launch gate and RFC5-15 egress choke point; make un-enforceable cost kinds non-delegable; reconcile RFC10-10 with RFC10-17), B2 (collapse or define reversible), B3 (settle whether provider egress is inside the effects-applied predicate), B4/B5/B6, RD1b-A, RD1b-B, plus the cheap ones both reviewers named: N1, N3, N5 (RFC-0004 and RFC-0011 missing from depends_on), N7 (the state diagram). Then a fresh review over the new bytes by a reviewer who wrote none of it.
acceptance_criteria: RFC-0010 package split; all six blocking findings repaired; a fresh independent review over the new exact bytes returns CONFIRM or EXCEPTIONS; MISSION-SAFETY-CLOSURE-REPORT updated. The repair pass may not be its own confirming reviewer.
notes: Round-2026-08d (commit 771965c): RFC-0010 split into a five-module package; all eight blocking findings repaired in candidate bytes (B1 six-quantity ledger + enforced-limit admission at RFC5-21/RFC5-15; B2 reversible defined narrowly; B3 egress dimension in RFC10-23; B4 duration-typed park limb + expiry defaults; B5 finite stop default + hang-is-failed-stop; B6 promoted to clause RFC10-24; RD1b-A release rows incl. parent-termination + max-time-to-first-dispatch; RD1b-B hold-and-mint deferral). Cheap ones N1/N3/N5/N7 taken in same pass. Title says six, description enumerates eight — eight is correct per closure report. Fresh-context reviews (rd13 mission-prevention, rd14 mission-effects, plus wave D1/D2 exact-package reviewers) are running against the frozen clone at 771965c; bead closes when a confirming verdict lands and the new closure report is written.

description: From review RD-6 (REVISE, 19 findings, 5 closed). The family that matters: F-1 through F-4 and A-3 are one shape — a rule that lives only inside its own enforcement, or an authority citation that does not resolve. Five thresholds the checker enforces and prints every run cite charter sections that do not exist; four of the five wait on the uninstalled CC-BUDGET-* family (owner packet 7). Nothing yet checks that a quotation matches its source — the defect two independent reviewers found in one week.
